items.title: Epoch AI data centers (global) — 2026-09-29
items.summary: Epoch AI covers 93 large AI data centers (73 drawing power now): 13.5 GW current power, 14.0M H100-equivalents, 10 countries with capacity. By power: United States 11.85 GW (88%), China 0.73 GW (5%), Malaysia 0.56 GW (4%), United Kingdom 0.09 GW (1%). Indiana: 3 sites, 1.09 GW = 8.1% of the covered global total (Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle (910 MW), Meta Jeffersonville (178 MW), Google Fort Wayne (0 MW)). Covered set only, not world capacity; skewed to the US. Dataset updated 2026-09-28.
